$comment: Baseline of scripts/retired-forms-lint.ts (S482, s482-retired-lint). `soft`: a SOFT ledger row's starting count per file — it may only go down (ruling user-voice-scrml.md S482 "every retirement / deprecation PR adds a retired-forms ledger row and migrates": "for a deprecated form, record the starting count, which then only goes down"). `pending`: HARD debt, dated, printed on every run, may only shrink — NOT an allow-list: each row says why it is not migrated yet. Sequencing: ruling user-voice-scrml.md S482 "every SPEC example is in the current language …" — "sequenced after the `/}` cleanup and the gate, chapter group by chapter group". Counts are per HIT (#2101 r1). Every (row, file) count must EQUAL the actual count: when hits are migrated, lower it with `bun scripts/retired-forms-lint.ts --update` (never raises) in the same change. CI and the pre-commit hook also compare this file against the base revision's (`--base-ref`): no count above the base's, no new key, no debt for a new HARD row.
